description:
SUBSTRATE BUG — surfaced by origindex ARGUS during the wfd.1 verdict-write (2026-05-24); routed up by user-tier POLYBIUS.

The save-verdict skill fails on Windows git-bash:
- heredoc-with-quoted-EOF blocks (<<'EOF' ... EOF) fail in the skill's invocation pattern.
- /tmp/ resolves differently between git-bash and Python on Windows — a path written by one isn't found by the other.

IMPACT: CAPTAINs (e.g. ARGUS) can't reliably write verdicts via save-verdict on Windows. They work around it, but it is friction + a latent correctness risk (a failed write that reads as success).

FIX DIRECTION: make save-verdict Windows-robust — drop the bash-heredoc-with-quoted-EOF pattern; resolve a portable temp location consistently (don't assume bash /tmp == Python /tmp on Windows); ideally write + read through the same runtime. Verify on a Windows git-bash + Python combo.

RELATED: u--h8q (user-tier) — PowerShell-tool canary. Same class of Windows-shell quirk; a native PowerShell tool would sidestep heredoc/temp-path mismatches. If the canary passes, that may be the broader fix; this skill fix stands regardless.
title: save-verdict skill fails on Windows git-bash (heredoc-EOF + /tmp bash-vs-Python mismatch)
